title: Backup capacity (robustness)
question: Which peak-backup capacity is installed: the base-year nameplates or the TL-15 robust nameplates?

options.label: Keep the base-year backup nameplates of C2-opt (electric_chiller_mw 8.20, peak_boiler_mw 5.00 MW)
options.notes: C2-opt: TL-15 P(demand met) 0.46 with the installed backups

options.label: Install the TL-15 P90 robust backups (electric_chiller_mw 8.20, peak_boiler_mw 10.90 MW) as C2-opt-robust
options.notes: C2-opt-robust: TL-15 P(demand met) 0.90; vs C2-opt ΔLCOH +2.05, ΔLCOC +0.00 USD/MWh, ΔCAPEX +2.21 MUSD (full year); recommended (OPT-ROBUST-BACKUP)

choice_label: Install the TL-15 P90 robust backups (electric_chiller_mw 8.20, peak_boiler_mw 10.90 MW) as C2-opt-robust

criterion.text: register rule OPT-ROBUST-BACKUP: install robust_backup_mw when it raises probability_demand_met

rationale: Criterion opt-robust-backup mandates installing robust backups when they raise probability_demand_met, per register rule OPT-ROBUST-BACKUP.

rejected.reason: Option installed-backup fails criterion opt-robust-backup because it does not raise probability_demand_met, unlike p90-robust-backup.
